$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId pins the actor created by the first deploy (2026-11-08, build 1.0.2), so a rename keeps the same actor.
seoTitle: Naukri Jobs Scraper - Salary, Skills and Experience
seoDescription: Search every job on naukri.com by keyword, city, experience and pay in lakhs. Get salary, key skills, company rating and apply links. No login needed.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, measured on Apify on 2026-11-08 (build 1.0.2): the example input took 21.2 s and $0.001252 at 512 MB, 17.6 s and $0.001645 at 1 GB, 16.3 s and $0.002465 at 2 GB, peaking at 63 to 65 MB; every run at 512 MB peaked at 56 to 90 MB. The work waits on Naukri, so 1 GB is 17% faster for 31% more cost and 2 GB 23% faster for 97% more; the start fee is one event up to 1 GB either way. Timeout 1800 s: 1,000 jobs took 25 s and 100 jobs with full details 35 s.

pricing.$comment: Cost plus markup (owner, 2026-11-08, BRIEF-3): FREE 150%, BRONZE 140%, SILVER 125%, GOLD 110%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 100% over the measured Apify cost at each tier's unit prices, rounded up to two significant figures, never under $0.00001. Measured on Apify (8 runs at 512 MB: E8fQPNKwSGsQZL9sC, zHWG7IFukI8Aa1o5F, hIBYthZ0EVnXEeAMy, PeRBapy4XJgixuUpu, rAcpysqPWAv9RI1Ak, EpipgkyeNwchrbn9U, FEybFxRPVwXFhoR9k, ieFTNIj4PK3RB8umu): a run costs $0.000503 + $0.00000539 a job + $0.00001158 a job with details at FREE unit prices (docs.apify.com/platform/actors/publishing/monetize/pricing-and-costs.md); PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's unit prices. Margin (SEO.md 16.4, 1 - cost / (0.8 x price)) per tier: job FREE 60.4%, BRONZE 60.4%, SILVER 57.0%, GOLD 55.6%, PLATINUM 55.6%, DIAMOND 55.6%; job-details FREE 60.9%, BRONZE 58.6%, SILVER 56.2%, GOLD 52.5%, PLATINUM 52.5%, DIAMOND 52.5%. Apify stores PLATINUM and DIAMOND at GOLD's price whatever is sent (first set, 2026-11-08: $0.000011 sent, $0.000012 stored), so they carry GOLD's price here too. The run start, $0.0025 flat, is 150% over the fixed cost of a run ($0.0016) raised so the example at 1 GB clears a 100% markup on FREE; every measured run type clears it on every tier. Written by pricing/calc_pricing.py from block_cost.json.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, places, remote or office, experience, pay, key skills, company rating, posting dates and link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, job type, department, role, industry, education, applicants, the employer's website and apply link.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
